name: Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Eco-certification of Coffee
benefit:
> **Extent of Support/ Subsidy**

**Certification Support:** 50% of the certification cost, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000 (Rupees 50,000) per individual grower/grower groups. In the case of Organic certification, spread over a period of 3 years or the conversion period, whichever is less; in the case of other certificates, one year, during the Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (
_eligibility_text: 1. The individual grower should own up to 10 hectares of coffee holding. 1. The group of small growers such as SHGs or collectives should obtain certification for sustainability and quality standards. 1. The grower should not have availed subsidy for the same activity during the Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture period unless new beneficiaries are covered. 1. The grower or group should obtain certification under recognized programs such as Organic, Fair Trade, Rainforest Alliance, UTZ Certified, or Bird Friendly/Shade Grown coffee standards. 1. The grower claiming support for organic certification should be certified under the National Programme for Organic Production standards. 1. The grower or group should obtain certification only from agencies accredited by the respective certification programs. 1. The non-tribal grower in non-traditional areas should have a coffee holding of up to 10 hectares.
